name: Two Point Museum VR
description: Your museum as a living model on the table in front of you.

knownIssues.title: Crate openings show on a flat screen
knownIssues.text: Opening an expedition crate and other scenes away from the museum show on a big flat screen instead of the table. The table comes back when you return to the museum.

knownIssues.title: Save pictures can come out blank
knownIssues.text: A museum saved while in VR may show a plain dark picture on the level select card. The save itself is fine.

knownIssues.title: The monitor doesn't show the game's menus
knownIssues.text: While you're in VR, the game's menus are drawn in the headset only, so someone watching the monitor won't see them.
